ctda_layout_note: Skyrim INFO CTDA decoded as type/comparison/function/params/run-on/reference while preserving raw fields.

speaker_resolution_policy.exact_form_or_scene: GetIsID/GetIsAliasRef or SCEN dialogue action alias resolves to a concrete plugin form.
speaker_resolution_policy.exact_semantic_custom_voice: Custom voice type is character-specific in this continuity; technical talking-activator proxies do not change persona.
speaker_resolution_policy.exact_talking_activator_voice: Custom voice type uniquely identifies a talking activator.
speaker_resolution_policy.role_level_custom_voice: Custom voice identifies a role/class but not necessarily a unique physical individual.
speaker_resolution_policy.shared_custom_voice_candidates: Custom voice is intentionally shared; candidates are retained instead of forcing attribution.
speaker_resolution_policy.contextual_wailway_train_not_condition_p: Wailway quest context strongly identifies the train, but INFO itself lacks a deterministic speaker condition; kept separate from exact resolutions.

external_function_reference_notes: Function IDs follow standard Skyrim condition-function numbering; raw IDs are always retained so future tooling can re-decode independently.
